mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish on our weather, which features clear skies near the Verona Public Library and a temperature of 77 degrees, along with a moderate air quality alert of 53.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest for Verona students is moving into its next phase, with community voting scheduled from July 28 to August 7 to select winning designs for the November election. Additionally, the city has issued a reminder about the mailbox damage policy, urging residents to inspect mailboxes for the upcoming winter season and follow official specifications to avoid potential replacement issues.

We have a busy few days ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market returns to the Capitol Square, and Paddy Mac's will host their own live music series.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from July 13 where an officer responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock; the driver, a 36-year-old man, was arrested for an O-W-I.
You can satisfy your sweet tooth with today's featured flavor, the Chocolate Volcano, available at the Verona Culver's until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
